# The Disciplined Club

> A membership that gives ambitious beginners the structure, live guidance, and community to build an online business — built by operators, not gurus.

## What it is
The Disciplined Club is a paid online membership. Members get new monthly modules, weekly live Q&A calls, a private community, and ongoing guidance focused on building online income, discipline, and direction. It is an environment and a system for taking action — not just another folder of videos.

## Who it is for
Ambitious beginners who feel stuck or unsure where to start online and want structure, accountability, and an environment that makes building feel inevitable. It is not for people who want results without consistent effort.

## Offer
Early-bird pricing, two plans:
- Early Bird Monthly: EUR 94.95 per month (regular EUR 118.69).
  Checkout: https://whop.com/disciplined-by-kim/early-bird-monthly-the-disciplined-club/
- Early Bird Yearly: EUR 1000 per year (regular EUR 1250) — saves EUR 139.40 against paying monthly.
  Checkout: https://whop.com/disciplined-by-kim/early-bird-year-the-disciplined-club/

Includes: monthly growth modules, weekly live Q&A calls, a private like-minded community, and guidance/discipline/structure.
